_comment: R3-06 claims-audit wave, probes for batches 4-7 (36 skills, 197 contradicted claims). One probe per contradicted-claim class the writer+reviewer recipe fixed. Arm A = model alone, arm B = model + the owning skill's SKILL.md + llm-anti-patterns.md (run_lift). Quotes are verbatim lines from scratchpad/corpus264 (264) or scratchpad/corpus (262). Built 2026-10-20.

probes.question: Does field history tracking data count against an org's data storage limit?
probes.wrong_answer: Yes, each history row consumes about 2 KB of data storage, so heavy tracking inflates storage.
probes.correct_answer: No. Field history tracking data does not count against data storage limits.
probes.quote: Field history tracking data doesn’t count against your data storage limits.
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: 'history records count toward data storage' with 2 KB arithmetic

probes.question: When a person account record is inserted or updated, which triggers fire: Account triggers, Contact triggers, or both?
probes.wrong_answer: Both, because a person account is an Account with a hidden Contact; write the Contact trigger to skip PersonContacts.
probes.correct_answer: Account triggers only. Inserts, updates, and deletes on person accounts fire Account triggers, not Contact triggers.
probes.quote: Inserts, updates, and deletes on person accounts fire Account triggers, not Contact triggers.
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: Contact trigger pattern skipping PersonContacts

probes.question: When you deploy Profile metadata to a target org, does it replace the profile's existing settings or overlay them?
probes.wrong_answer: It is a full replace: any field permission not in the file is cleared in the target.
probes.correct_answer: It overlays the existing settings. Disabled permissions are not exported, so to force a disablement you add it explicitly with <value>false</value>.
probes.quote: We designed Profile metadata deployment to overlay the existing Profile settings in a target org.
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: 'Profile deploy is a full-replace that clears FLS'

probes.question: What happens if you start a second Metadata API deployment while one is already running in the same org?
probes.wrong_answer: The second fails immediately with a lock contention error.
probes.correct_answer: It is queued. Only one deployment runs at a time; queued deployments appear under Pending Deployments and are not necessarily executed in submission order.
probes.quote: You can initiate multiple deployments, but only one deployment can run at a time. The other deployments remain in the queue waiting
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: 'a second validation fails with a lock contention error'

probes.question: How many custom notification actions can a subscriber org execute per hour?
probes.quote: A subscriber org can execute up to 10,000 notification actions per hour.

probes.question: What is the format of versionNumber in sfdx-project.json for a package, and where does the keyword NEXT go?
probes.wrong_answer: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.NEXT is the only valid form; NEXT must always be the fourth segment.
probes.correct_answer: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.BUILD, for example 1.2.1.8; NEXT may be used in the BUILD slot to auto-increment, but an explicit build number is also valid.
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit and its checker: 'NEXT only', flagged the guide's own 1.2.1.8

probes.question: If Apex calls out to a hard-coded URL instead of a Named Credential, what must exist for the callout to succeed?
probes.wrong_answer: Nothing extra: hard-coded endpoints bypass callout enforcement, which is why they are risky.
probes.correct_answer: The site must be registered in Remote Site Settings or the callout fails; only a Named Credential endpoint needs no remote site setting.
probes.quote: Before any Apex callout can call an external site, that site must be registered in the Remote Site Settings page, or the
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: 'hard-coded endpoints bypass callout enforcement'

probes.question: When a Named Credential or External Credential is included in a managed package, are its tokens and secrets packaged with it?
probes.wrong_answer: Yes, the credential definition including its stored token travels with the package metadata.
probes.correct_answer: No. The Metadata API cannot fully expose a credential's definition or render tokens in plain text, so packaged credentials do not include the secrets.
probes.quote: the standard Metadata API can’t fully expose the definition of a
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: the claim was marked unverifiable in 4 places

probes.question: In Manufacturing Cloud Advanced Account Forecasting, is a forecast set recalculated automatically, and what controls how often?
probes.wrong_answer: No. Recalculation is never automatic; you run a Data Processing Engine job nightly by hand.
probes.correct_answer: Yes. AdvAccountForecastSet.calculationFrequency sets the frequency at which the forecast set is recalculated automatically (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly or Yearly).
probes.quote: The frequency at which the forecast set is recalculated automatically.
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: 'ABF recalc is nightly via DPE, no automatic run'

probes.question: After you suspend sharing rule calculations for a bulk load and then resume them, does Salesforce automatically bring sharing back in line?
probes.wrong_answer: Yes. Clearing the deferral collapses all pending changes into one recalculation job that runs automatically.
probes.correct_answer: No. After resuming, you must manually initiate a full sharing rule recalculation to prevent errors.
probes.wrong_source: skill before audit: 'clearing deferral collapses into one job' in 9 places
